description: Several large Lego-style blocks are spread out on the bed: a green block, two red blocks, a white block, and a yellow block. The right hand picks up a red block from the right side and brings it toward the center, then grasps the yellow block and stacks it onto the white block; next the right hand adds a red block on top of the growing stack, and finally lifts the green block and places it on top, while the left hand stays nearby without touching any block.
